reason: My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, he did not tell me to take a specific product. I would get the blood test first and ask him what to take, not buy off TikTok Shop on a maybe.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule? And $29.99 a month for something I am not even sure I am low on feels like a lot.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor confirming I am low and telling me bisglycinate alone is fine, or a plain explanation of why one form is enough, plus a lower price.
